title: Space intelligences chose Owens for the strongest nervous system since Moses
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Space intelligences chose Owens for the strongest nervous system since Moses, about Owens' childhood onward at not stated, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He would claim that they discovered he had the most powerful nervous system of anybody they had ever encountered since Moses.

plain: A parapsychology researcher named Jeffrey Mishlove tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a man named Ted Owens. According to Mishlove, Owens claimed that intelligences from space had picked him because they found he had the most powerful nervous system of anyone they had met since Moses. If true, it would mean these beings choose certain humans as special contacts.
